name: ZX_TAX_ALLOCS_INTERFACE
description: This table stores the transaction line information to which the external tax line should be allocated to.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Column to temporarily store identifier of the interface line corresponding to the transaction line during import of transactions into Receivables

columns.name: INTERFACE_TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Column to temporarily store identifier of the interface line corresponding to this tax line during import of transactions into Receivables

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the transaction

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Event class code of the transaction

columns.name: INTERFACE_LINE_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Column to temporarily store entity code of the transaction line interface table

columns.name: INTERFACE_TAX_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Column to temporarily store entity code of the tax line interface table

columns.name: LINE_AMT
columns.description: Transaction line amount

columns.name: SUMMARY_TAX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Summary tax line number for the imported tax line

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: LOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request status of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Alphanumeric identifier on a transaction.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier of a line on a transaction.

columns.name: TAX_ALLOC_APPL_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the transaction.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: To identify the name of the batch containing external taxable transactions.
